contractSource: Description: "Calculate glass panel dimensions instantly for windows, doors, and partitions." Inputs: opening size, clearances on each side, number of panels, gap between panels.
groundTruth: Glass height = opening height − top − bottom clearance. Width available = opening width − left − right clearance; with n panels there are n − 1 gaps; each panel = (available − gaps) ÷ n.

cases.derivation: Opening 1,200 × 2,000 mm, 5 mm clearance each side, 2 panels, 10 mm gap. Height = 2,000 − 5 − 5 = 1,990 mm. Width available = 1,200 − 10 = 1,190 mm; one gap of 10 mm leaves 1,180; ÷ 2 = 590 mm per panel.
